company.name: Cloverleaf AI
company.productCategory: Government meeting intelligence and early sales signals
company.description: Monitors public government meetings and delivers early buying signals, decision-maker profiles, and competitive intel to GovTech vendors' sales teams.

customerObjectives: Source pipeline before RFPs go public

adoption: Speaker ID used to track decision-makers

maturityStages.name: Activated
maturityStages.definition: Basic setup, alerts configured, some logins.

maturityStages.name: Converting
maturityStages.definition: At least one deal sourced from intel; reps acting on signals.

maturityStages.name: Embedded
maturityStages.definition: Part of the sales workflow; leadership engaged; CRM integration.

maturityStages.name: Expanding
maturityStages.definition: New territories, verticals, or features; reference-worthy.

ch.sponsor_engaged.label: Sales leader engaged
ch.sponsor_engaged.definition: A VP, Director, or C-level sales leader appears and engages.

ad.depth.label: Reps act on alerts
ad.depth.definition: Reps act on alerts and use meeting intelligence in outreach, not just receive digests.

roi.outcomes_evidenced.label: Deals sourced
roi.outcomes_evidenced.definition: Specific deals or pipeline traced to a government meeting or alert. GovTech cycles run 12 to 24 months, so early signals acted on count.

assessmentGuidance: ROI is measured in deals sourced from signals, pipeline influenced, and relationships built before procurement starts.
